title: laundry cart
text: laundry cart. This is very flimsy!!  Not sturdy at all!  I cannot recommend this!  Always feels like it will break when wash is in it.  Also it came with a wheel part that was damaged.  But the company was great & made good for it.

product_metadata.title: Fox Valley Traders EasyComforts Laundry Cart with Wheels, Collapsible with Removable Liner, Rolling Hamper Cart with Tubular Metal Frame, White Bag Included – Measures 23" x 18" x 32"
features: Roll Your Laundry – With this convenient laundry cart, you can roll your laundry instead of carrying it; save your back and easily move your wash
Sturdy Frame – Thoughtfully constructed with a tubular metal frame to ensure longevity; when basket liner is removed, the frame collapses for easy storage
Smooth-Rolling Casters – The weight of your wash is evenly distributed among 4 smooth-rolling wheels, making it easy to move around
Removeable Basket Liner – Transferable laundry bag is designed of heavyweight, preshrunk, machine washable cotton; 1 bag is included and additional replacement bags can be purchased separately
Product Specifications – Laundry cart measures approximately 23” L x 18” W x 32” H with 1 ¾” wheels
description: With the laundry cart, roll your laundry instead of carrying it. The rolling laundry cart has a tubular metal frame that is 23" x 18" x 32"H, 1 3/4" wheels. Cart comes with one white bag. Replacement bags for the canvas laundry cart available separately. All bags are heavyweight, preshrunk, machine washable cotton. Imported.
